headline: SAFF holds 4.32 on Female Daily (flat vs yesterday and 7 days ago); official Tokopedia pages for Coco, Las Pozas and Cascavel all show 4.9 with about 1% or less at 1–2 stars.
kpis_note: Awareness and NPS need a consumer survey; they are not measured from public web data.

insights.text: Female Daily today: SAFF 4.32 (1,747 reviews) and Alchemist 4.43 (569) unchanged vs 26 Nov and 20 Nov; no SAFF product score moved. HMNS, Mykonos and Onix pages could not be read today (last: 4.20, 4.27, 4.17).
S.O.T.B (4.1, 586 reviews) still makes up a third of SAFF's Female Daily reviews, so it sets the brand score more than any other scent.
Official-store proof keeps growing: Las Pozas 4.9 from 4,282 Tokopedia ratings, Coco 4.9 from 4,136 and Cascavel 4.9 from 1,992, each at or below about 1% 1–2 stars.
Oily texture is a repeat caveat in long-form Lemon8 reviews (fabric marks), even when wear time (6–8+ hours) is praised.
Mykonos' 2026 launches split: Nautilus scores 8.7 from 44 Parfumo ratings (praised for value as a designer alternative), while Mayfair sits at 6.2 from 5.

recommendations.text: Confirm whether the 'saffnco.batam' Instagram account is an official partner; if not, report it and pin a list of official accounts and stores (Tokopedia, Blibli, Zalora) on the main profile.
Use product-level proof such as Las Pozas 4.9 from 4,282 and Coco 4.9 from 4,136 Tokopedia ratings in ads and product pages, not store-wide scores.
Add a 'spray on skin, not on fabric' tip to product pages and inserts to answer the oily-texture caveat.
For S.O.T.B, add 'how much to spray' and 'best for evening / cool rooms' guidance in copy to answer 'too strong' and 'common' complaints.
Run a quarterly survey (awareness, NPS) and upload a marketplace export to the Drive folder so low-star themes can be tracked.
